title: Codefall review findings
description: One round of review findings for one target. Written to .codefall/reviews/<target-key>/round-NNN/findings.json, and handed to an external harness so its output arrives in this shape rather than as prose.

key.description: The directory name this round lives under: a commit SHA, a slugged branch name, pr-<number>, uncommitted, or a slugged document path.

ref.description: What the user named, before resolution.

upstream.description: Path of the document this target was checked against. Absent for code targets and for a concept.

harness.description: host for this session's own model, or the external CLI that ran: codex, claude, opencode, gemini.

lenses.description: The lenses this round actually ran, after any focus= narrowing.

notChecked.description: What could not be reviewed, and why: no design behind the branch, no upstream document, a lens skipped for lack of context.

id.description: Stable within the target across rounds: <lens>-<nn>.

heading.description: For a document target: the section the finding sits in.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

conditions.description: When it manifests. Empty or absent means always.

patch.description: A proposed diff, in unified format. A recommendation only — review never applies it.

status.description: A finding this round wrote is open. Later rounds set resolved or stale; only a person sets dismissed, and a dismissed finding is never revived.
